component.name: The Texodus Trail
component.summary: The Oregon Trail for the California-to-Texas exodus

description.p: It's 2026, rent in San Francisco is $3,950 and gas is $6.89 a gallon. Load up a Yoo-Haul, strap the mattress to the roof and point it at Austin: 1,880 miles of I-40, two river crossings, one 72 oz steak and a Buc-ee's the size of a regional airport.

ul.li: The whole Oregon Trail loop: pick an occupation, name your party, shop, drive, rest, trade, ford rivers and bury your friends
Fifteen landmarks along the real route, and gas that gets cheaper every state
Food Truck Frenzy, the hunting minigame, for people who have only ever hunted parking spots
Graves that stay: every future trip passes the tombstones your past parties left
Side-scrolling pixel art, weather, and an original chiptune soundtrack

description.p: Made for Omarchy, where the menus wear your current theme and restyle live when you switch themes. Everywhere else it uses its own built-in colours.
No accounts, no telemetry and no network access. Your trip, the Top Ten and the sound setting are saved in your home directory.

You have died of state income tax

description.p: An AppImage, with Quickshell and Qt inside, so the game runs on other Linux distributions too.
The installed game knows its version: About and texodus --about show the release instead of "dev".
First release, with the About screen (F1, or texodus --about).
